Demo43 風雪客栈 (白嶺の峠、ひと晩の宿) — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6 标准制作流程) → project/web_prompts.json
for tools/openai/images.py (Seedance API upload was rate-limited, 429 / Retry-After 64409 s on 2026-11-08 → OpenAI per §5.3).

Characters = special versions of the for-men heroines (face, hair colour, personality, voice unchanged; outfit / hairstyle / identity
changed — docs/proposals/2026-11-08_crossover.md M1-East). References copied into assets/art/ (not linked, so nothing is ever written
into the original demos): ref_mint (Demo37), ref_hinata (Demo18), ref_nagisa (Demo31) + a closer face reference each.
Step 1: two design options per character (design_<char>_a / _b) → the coordinator picks one each; the pick becomes that character's
base pose (<char>_base) by copy. Step 2: the other poses / variants reference the pick.
Chroma screens (guide §6): Mint has mint-green hair → magenta #FF00FF ("matte": "magenta"); Hinata and Nagisa → green #00B140.
Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

design_mint_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young woman (her face, eyes, hair colour). Image 2 is the same woman closer (face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: modern anime cel illustration (the same series), thin dark-lavender lineart, flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom, not realistic, not 3D. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), about 7 heads tall, a beautiful adult face.

Keep her FACE exactly as in images 1 and 2: the same eye shape, eye colour, eyebrows, nose, mouth, face shape and expression style — the same person, recognisable at once. Only her clothes and hairstyle change.

Mint: the exact young woman from images 1-2 — very long hair in pale mint green fading to white at the tips, sleepy pale aqua-blue eyes with heavy lids, soft gentle face, fair skin. Her small silver STAR hair ornament is now a star-shaped jade hairpin. Identity: a travelling woman doctor who 'cures people even half asleep'.

She now lives in an imaginary snowy East-Asian-flavoured mountain land of long ago (an invented country, not any real dynasty or era): practical layered cloth garments with wrap collars, quilted and fur-lined winter wear, cords and sashes. NOT a Chinese palace costume, NOT a Japanese kimono or miko outfit, no Tang hats, no court robes, nothing modern (no zips, no hoodies, no headphones).

Outfit A: layered long travelling robes in pale green and off-white with a wrap collar, a soft white fur-lined short capelet, a wide pale-green sash, a small wooden medicine chest on a strap at her hip, a cloth roll of needles tucked in the sash. Hair A: her long hair gathered into ONE loose low braid hanging over her front shoulder, the star jade hairpin above her ear, the white-mint tips at the end of the braid, soft loose strands framing her face.

She stands facing the viewer, from the thighs up, centre, at eye level, one hand resting on the medicine box strap at her waist, a sleepy, gentle half-smile, eyes half-lidded. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on her: warm amber lamplight from the LEFT of the picture, soft and dim, a faint cool rim on the right.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY MAGENTA background (#FF00FF), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no magenta or pink anywhere on her. Her whole head and hair inside the frame with space above; her shoulders, arms and elbows not cut by the left or right picture edge (full figure inside the frame with margin at the sides).

Wide 16:9 game art. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.
